beats.subtitle: cheese loaded into the bowl, or set aside on the table: the same practice start

narration.text: The agent extends the first job's check to both goals and tests changes. Going home between skills: 8 of 10. beats.title: The instrument
beats.subtitle: two lags that look the same in telemetry

narration.text: Story two: a fleet of arms at several sites, with the same lag at one site and on one robot elsewhere. The agent builds its own probe, commanded against measured: one lag is a fixed network delay, the other a controller falling behind.

beats.title: The fleet, repaired
beats.subtitle: reserved attempts the agent never saw, before and after

narration.text: After paired experiments it compensates for the delay, rolls back an update and services the controller. On 576 reserved attempts it never saw, success rises from 451 to 558: 113 rescued, 6 broken.
Two jobs at 20 and 20 of 20 reserved starts, and a fleet improved by an instrument the agent built. The policy never changed; every clip is a recorded run.
